newsitem.title: UK: London platinum fixed at lowest since October 1993.
newsitem.headline: London platinum fixed at lowest since October 1993.

text.p: Platinum, under pressure following a sharp drop in gold prices, was fixed at $362.75 an ounce on Monday morning, its lowest fixing since October 8, 1993.
It was previously fixed at $366.00 an ounce on Friday afternoon.
Weakness in gold was weighing on the other precious metals, including silver, platinum and palladium, dealers said.
"Gold is the leader," a dealer noted, adding that the metal was likely to drop further and drag the rest of the precious metals complex down with it.
Platinum demand was suffering from substitution by its cheaper sister metal palladium in key areas such as autocatalyst coatings from the car industry, dealers said.
Palladium was fixed at $117.75 an ounce, compared with $119.75 at its previous fixing.
